title: Recovering incomplete stage evidence
objective: Create a recovery plan for a strong workshop with no sponsor or metric owner.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Blueprints rarely go perfectly. A workshop may be strong while a sponsor is missing, or a use case may be compelling with no one able to supply baseline data. The skill is choosing the smallest corrective action that closes the gap.
Match the fix to the gap

blocks.x: Progress is not more meetings. It is the next decision becoming better informed. If no executive priority supports a use case, go back to qualification before building a bigger savings model. Without a baseline, any claimed improvement cannot be verified, so a missing baseline is an action to resolve, not a number to estimate quietly.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Don't quietly lower success criteria or backfill invented numbers to move the stage forward. Record the gap, its owner, the corrective action, and the decision checkpoint.
Most incomplete stages have a small, specific fix. Name the gap, then take the smallest step that closes it.
